Compute a²-b²+c²-d² = 1749.

Let S = a²+b²+c²+d². We want S.

Note a²-b²+c²-d² = (a²+c²) - (b²+d²) = 1749.

Also a²-b² = (a-b)(a+b), c²-d²=(c-d)(c+d).

All of a,b,c odd primes (a≥5,b≥7,c≥13 all odd). d: if d=2, d²=4 even; if d odd prime, d² odd.
